name: LuxLoader
description: Rendering pipeline loader for Minecraft Vulkan: registration, runtime switching, capability negotiation and diagnostics.

luxloader:notes: Vulkan is experimental since Minecraft 26.2 Snapshot 8; OpenGL is the default.
The loader remains idle on non-Vulkan backends. This is expected behavior.
Shared hooks integrate through FrontendGpuSurface. Observed capability checks detect unavailable hooks.
